title: A finite piece with one point over u survives a further base change with trivial residue field extension
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $\varphi:U\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $u\in U$, $s=\varphi(u)$, $x\in X$ with $f(x)=s$. Let $X_U=X\times_SU$ be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $p:X_U\to X$, $q:X_U\to U$, and let $V\subseteq X_U$ be an open subscheme such that (i) $V\hookrightarrow X_U\xrightarrow{q}U$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], (ii) there is exactly one point $v\in V$ with $q(v)=u$, (iii) $p(v)=x$ and the map $\kappa(x)\to\kappa(v)$ induced by $p$ on residue fields [def-weil-residue-field] is an isomorphism. Let $\psi:U'\to U$ be a morphism of schemes and $u'\in U'$ with $\psi(u')=u$ such that $\kappa(u)\to\kappa(u')$ (induced by $\psi$) is an isomorphism. Let $X_{U'}=X\times_SU'$ be the fibre product of $f$ and $\varphi\circ\psi$, with projections $p':X_{U'}\to X$, $q':X_{U'}\to U'$, let $\pi:X_{U'}\to X_U$ be the morphism with $p\circ\pi=p'$ and $q\circ\pi=\psi\circ q'$, and let $V'=\pi^{-1}(V)$, an open subscheme of $X_{U'}$. Then (i') $V'\hookrightarrow X_{U'}\xrightarrow{q'}U'$ is finite, (ii') there is exactly one point $v'\in V'$ with $q'(v')=u'$, and (iii') $p'(v')=x$ and $\kappa(x)\to\kappa(v')$ (induced by $p'$) is an isomorphism; moreover $\pi(v')=v$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 02LK (more-morphisms-lemma-etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite-at-point), final assertion (lines 11951-11954: for an elementary etale neighbourhood $(U',u')\to(U,u)$ the triple $(U',u',U'\times_UV)$ again satisfies (i)-(iii)); Stacks gives no proof of it, and its proof of Lemma 02LL (lines 11998-12011) applies it to opens $V_i$ obtained earlier, i.e. to any triple satisfying (i)-(iii). Stated here for an arbitrary $\psi$ with $\kappa(u)\cong\kappa(u')$ (etaleness of $\psi$ is not needed); the agent's formulation.

mathlib_searches.query: base change of a finite morphism along a morphism with trivial residue field extension keeps a unique point in the fibre with the same residue field
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match (only the clause (i'), finite is stable under base change, which is lem-weil-pbc-finite-morphism-permanence)

mathlib_searches.query: pullback of a scheme morphism: points of the fibre over u' of the base change correspond to points over u when residue field of u' equals residue field of u
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: the PullbackCarrier API (points of a pullback = triplets with a prime of the tensor product of residue fields) is the tool for the proof, not the statement
